I am so sorry about that — being 21 days past your expected delivery date is definitely not right, and I completely understand your frustration. 

I can see that the ₹250 delay credit has already been added to your account for this order, which will show at checkout. Because BlueDart hasn't delivered your Court Sneakers yet, I've escalated this to a colleague to investigate as a lost parcel. 

Your reference is **ESC-TR-4525-05120000**, and someone will be in touch with you shortly.
